correctness.rationale: For the centered K_{2,q} unit-edge zonotope, the coordinate map (t_1,...,t_q,s)->sum_j t_j((e_A+e_B)/2-e_j)+s(e_A-e_B) is injective; the exact fiber is |s|<=W(t)/2 with W=q-sum_j|t_j| and t_j in [-1,1]. Gram det=q+2 gives Euclidean Jacobian sqrt(q+2). Integrating the uniform-volume density proportional to W yields E(t_j^2)=(2q-1)/(6q) and E(s^2)=q(q+1)/48, with all mixed covariances zero by sign symmetry. The leaf contrasts, leaf-hub aggregate and hub-difference axes have eigenvalues (2q-1)/(6q) (mult q-1), (2q-1)(q+2)/(12q), q(q+1)/24. The polynomial difference q^3-3q^2-6q+4 changes sign between q=4 and q=5 and rises for q>=4. Volume=q2^{q-1}sqrt(q+2), trace and isotropic determinant follow exactly. Independently checked rational eigenvalues at q=2,3,4,5,6,7,8,15. The q=2 endpoint is a boundary, theorem q>=3.
